# Developer-machine requirements.
# This file is only an entry point: it includes two compiled, fully hashed lock
# files that pin the complete transitive dependency tree (uv pip compile
# --generate-hashes). Scan those for the exact installed versions.
# pip enforces --require-hashes as soon as any requirement carries a hash, so both
# files included below are fully hashed lock files generated by uv. Do not edit
# them by hand: change docker/requirements.in or requirements-dev.in and
# regenerate with the command in each .in file's header.
-r docker/requirements.txt
-r requirements-dev.txt
